blocks.prompt: 13. An object moving in a line is given an initial velocity of 4.5 m/s and a constant acceleration of 2.5 m/s\(^2\). How long will it take the object to reach a velocity of 20m/s?
blocks.explanation:
Constant acceleration 2.5 m/s\(^2\) ka matlab hai ke har second raftaar (velocity) barabar 2.5 m/s barhti hai. Har qadam par ek hi miqdaar jude to A.P. banti hai: 0, 1, 2, ... seconds par velocities 4.5, 7, 9.5, ...
Plan: \(t\) seconds baad ki velocity likhenge, usay 20 ke barabar rakhenge aur \(t\) nikalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(t = 0\) par \(u = 4.5\) m/s, acceleration 2.5 m/s\(^2\), aakhri velocity 20 m/s.
Humein find karna hai: waqt \(t\).
Tareeqa: \(t = 0, 1, 2, \ldots\) par velocities A.P. hain: pehla term 4.5, \(d = 2.5\), is liye \(v = 4.5 + 2.5t\) (physics ka \(v = u + at\) bhi yahi hai).

\(t\) seconds baad velocity
\[v = 4.5 + 2.5t\]
Kyun: Shuru (\(t = 0\)) par 4.5. Har second ek dafa 2.5 judta hai, to \(t\) seconds mein \(2.5t\). Yeh A.P. ka term hai jahan ginti \(t = 0\) se shuru hoti hai.

\(v = 20\) rakh kar hal karein
\[4.5 + 2.5t = 20\]
\[2.5t = 15.5\]
\[t = \dfrac{15.5}{2.5} = 6.2\]
Kyun: Dono taraf se 4.5 ghataya, phir 2.5 se divide kiya. \(15.5 \div 2.5 = 6.2\) seconds.

Tasdeeq
\[4.5 + 2.5(6.2) = 4.5 + 15.5 = 20 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(t = 6.2\) wapas rakha to velocity bilkul 20 m/s aayi.
Dhyan dein: agar A.P. ko \(a_n = 4.5 + (n - 1)(2.5)\) likhein to \(n\) term ka number hai, waqt nahi; \(n\)th term \(n - 1\) seconds par hota hai. \(n = 7.2\) ka matlab waqt \(7.2 - 1 = 6.2\) seconds.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein 7.2 seconds likha hai. Yeh \(4.5 + (n - 1)(2.5) = 20\) se nikla term number \(n\) hai, lekin \(n\)th term \(n - 1\) seconds baad ki velocity hai (pehla term \(t = 0\) par hai). Sahi waqt \(t = \frac{20 - 4.5}{2.5} = 6.2\) seconds hai.
